name: Octree Traversal
definition: A hierarchical indexing mechanism using a tree structure where each parent node contains 0 or 8 children, achieving a 2x2x2 regular subdivision of the parent node into 8 equal parts or 'leaves'. Used for occlusion and empty space skipping.
summary: Octree Traversal accelerates volume rendering by recursively subdividing 3D space into eight octants, distinguished by its explicit use of regular 2x2x2 subdivision and mid-plane sorting logic.
